Ein wahres Vergnügen und die Fotos schaue ich mir immer wieder gerne an, die dort entstanden sind. Und während der Fototour nicht vergessen, sich bei jedem Schmetterling/Vogel für das Stillhalten zu bedanken. Im angrenzenden Shop erhält jeder Besucher noch seinen ganz privaten Schmetterling, der mich jeden Tag an meinem Besuch erinnert.

Ferner ist ein Spaziergang durch Key West abseits der sog. Hauptstraße/n sehenswert. Key West hat einige sehr schöne (Holz)Häuser und Vorgärten zu bieten. Auch ist es abseits der Hauptstraße/n nicht so überlaufen.

(Translated by Google) The Capitol complex houses a wide variety of buildings and thus functions. With 22 floors, the New Capitol is the tallest building in the city and offers a great panoramic view of Tallahassee from the observation gallery. The large bronze seal of the State of Florida is located in the entrance hall. It is also noteworthy that as a tourist, after a security check, I can move around alone in the building analogous to the airport. The signage could be improved a lot for my taste, but there are very helpful staff. There is also the Old Capitol or Historic Capitol of Florida. This is a house with a dazzling light facade and red and white striped awnings in front of the windows. Since the whole thing is free, it is particularly worthwhile.

Then take a stroll through the city center.

(Original)
Der Capitol Komplex beherbergt unterschiedlichste Gebäude und somit Funktionen. Das New Capitol ist mit 22 Stockwerken das höchste Gebäude der Stadt und bietet von der Aussichtsgalerie einen tollen Rundumblick auf Tallahassee. In der Eingangshalle befindet sich das große Bronze-Siegel des Staates Florida. Bemerkenswert auch, dass ich als Tourist nach einer Sicherheitskontrolle analog zum Flughafen mich alleine im Gebäude bewegen darf. Die Ausschilderung könnte für meinen Geschmack deutlich verbessert werden, aber es gibt sehr hilfsbereite Mitarbeiter. Ferner gibt es noch das Old Capitol bzw. Historic Capitol of Florida. Dies ist ein Haus mit blendend heller Fassade und rot-weiß gestreiften Markisen vor den Fenstern. Da das ganze kostenlos ist, lohnt es sich besonders.

Im Anschluss noch einen Bummel durch die Innenstadt unternehmen.

(Translated by Google) Be there right at the beginning of the opening hours, so that you can enjoy the house / garden for yourself or with only a few other guests. In 1931 the literary man acquired this well-equipped building in the Spanish colonial style with a surrounding balcony. The rooms are originally furnished and a kind of flyer informs about the respective room (also in German, if desired). Descendants of Hemingway's cats frolic in the garden. But in any case, the cats at the time left marks in the concrete during construction. The chandeliers in the garden are also worth a look.

A walk through Key West away from the so-called main street (s) is also worth seeing. Key West has some very nice (wooden) houses and front gardens. It is also not so crowded off the main street / s.

(Original)
Gleich zu Beginn der Öffnungszeit da sein, so dass sie das Haus/Garten für sich alleine bzw. mit nur einigen sehr wenigen anderen Gästen genießen können. 1931 erwarb der Literat dieses gut ausgestattete im spanischen Kolonialstil errichtete Gebäude mit umlaufenden Balkon. Die Räume sind original eingerichtet und eine Art Flyer informiert über den jeweiligen Raum (auch auf Deutsch, sofern gewünscht). Im Garten tummeln sich (angeblich) Nachkommen von Hemingways Katzen. Aber auf jeden Fall haben die damaligen Katzen Abdrücke im Beton während des Baus hinterlassen. Auch die Kronleuchter im Garten sind einen Blick wert.

Ferner ist ein Spaziergang durch Key West abseits der sog. Hauptstraße/n sehenswert. Key West hat einige sehr schöne (Holz)Häuser und Vorgärten zu bieten. Auch ist es abseits der Hauptstraße/n nicht so überlaufen.

(Translated by Google) This is a museum of the circus kings of the same name. Here everything revolves around the theme of the circus and in some cases in a very original way. Old circus wagons, costumes and posters are shown here. The miniature circus, which is built on a huge surface and shows everything in detail, is particularly attractive, provided that the circus was really so huge and extensive. You can also visit the couple's villa, which was built in the style of a Venetian Renaissance palace. There is also an art museum that houses a significant collection of ancient art as well as European masterpieces (paintings). Replicas of famous statues adorn the inner courtyard of the art museum. Oh yes, the area is surrounded by a very well-kept garden including a rose garden.

(Original)
Dies ist ein Museum der gleichnamigen Zirkuskönige. Hier dreht sich alles um das Thema Zirkus und zwar auf teilweise sehr originelle Weise. Hier werden alte Zirkuswagen, Kostüme und Plakate gezeigt. Besonders anziehend ist der Miniaturzirkus, der auf einer riesigen Fläche aufgebaut ist und alles detailgenau zeigt, sofern der Zirkus wirklich so riesig und umfangreich war. Ferner kann noch die Villa des Ehepaares besichtigt werden, die im Stil eines venezianischen Renaissance-Palastes errichtet wurde. Außerdem gibt es noch ein Kunstmuseum, dass eine bedeutende Kollektion antiker Kunst wie auch europäische Meisterwerke (Gemälde) beherbergt. Den Innenhof des Kunstmuseum zieren Nachbildungen berühmter Statuen. Ach ja, die Anlage ist umgeben von einer sehr gepflegten Gartenanlage inklusive einem Rosengarten.

(Translated by Google) A very futuristic building that skillfully combines concrete and steel. The museum building fits the Catalan Salvador Dalí, the main representative of surrealism. On the adjacent site there is a "wish tree" on which the entry bands hang after a wish / dream has been immortalized - nice to see, especially when the bands flutter in the wind.

The museum houses the largest collection of the artist outside Europe. So the exhibition is quite extensive.
As is well known, art can be argued, as can taste. Nonetheless, I would recommend anyone to visit the museum when in the area. The museum is THE highlight in St. Petersburg.

(Original)
Ein sehr futuristisches Gebäude, das gekonnt Beton und Stahl vereint. Der Museumsbau passt genau zu dem Katalanen Salvador Dalí, dem Hauptvertreter des Surrealismus. Auf dem angrenzenden Gelände steht ein "Wunschbaum", an dem die Eintrittsbänder hängen, nachdem auf diesem ein Wunsch/Traum verewigt wurde - schön anzusehen, erst recht, wenn die Bänder im Wind flattern.

Das Museum beherbergt die größte außerhalb Europas befindliche Sammlung des Künstlers. Die Ausstellung ist also ziemlich umfangreich.
Über Kunst lässt sich ja bekanntlich streiten, ebenso über Geschmack. Nichtsdestotrotz würde ich jedem empfehlen, dem Museum einen Besuch abzustatten, wenn er in der Gegend ist. Das Museum ist DAS Highlight in St. Petersburg.

(Translated by Google) From the outside partly because the turret is very playful, but then the building exudes a cold austerity. I couldn't find anything inside the museum. The fact that the museum only has a few rooms didn't bother me. Absolutely not my case, and not appropriate for a museum either. Every centimeter felt like something was complete and I could not see any systematic. In my view, absolutely not worth a visit.

Then you'd better take a walk through Tampa and enjoy the view of the skyline. The Tampa Riverwalk invites you for a walk and maybe you will also discover the fish hanging in bright colors.

(Original)
Von außen teilweise ob der Türmchen sehr verspielt, aber dann strahlt das Gebäude doch wieder eine kalte Strenge aus. Innen konnte ich dem Museum nichts abgewinnen. Dass das Museum nur über wenige Räume verfügt, störte mich dabei nicht. Absolut nicht mein Fall, und auch für ein Museum nicht angebracht, ist dieses überbordende. Gefühlt jeder Zentimeter war mir irgendetwas vollgestellt und eine Systematik konnte ich dabei auch nicht erkennen. Aus meiner Sicht absolut keinen Besuch wert.

Dann doch lieber einen Spaziergang durch Tampa unternehmen und den Blick auf die Skyline genießen. Der Tampa Riverwalk lädt zu einem Spaziergang ein und vielleicht entdecken sie ja auch die aufgehängten Fische in knalligen Farben.

(Translated by Google) Art museum that is embedded in a wonderful park. The museum shows both older masterpieces u. a. by Albrecht Dürer and Lucas Cranach the Elder as well as modern art from the 21st century. The park is clearly the most beautiful. This consists of three gardens, which are simply dreamlike and border directly on the St. Johns River.

After visiting the museum, take a stroll into downtown Jacksonville along the Northbank Riverwalk along the St. Johns River. Great view of the Main Street Bridge ("Blue Wonders of Jacksonville") and the skyline. Some "art treasures" also cross the path, just keep your eyes open.

(Original)
Kunstmuseum, dass in eine herrliche Parkanlage eingebettet ist. Das Museum zeigt sowohl ältere Meisterwerke u. a. von Albrecht Dürer und Lucas Cranach dem Älteren als auch moderne Kunst aus dem 21. Jahrhundert. Am schönsten ist eindeutig die Parkanlage. Diese besteht aus drei Gärten, die einfach traumhaft gestaltet sind und direkt an den St. Johns River angrenzen.

Nach dem Besuch des Museums unbedingt einen Bummel in die Innenstadt von Jacksonville am Northbank Riverwalk am St. Johns River entlang unternehmen. Hierbei toller Blick auf die Main Street Bridge ("Blaue Wunder von Jacksonville") sowie die Skyline. Auch einige "Kunstschätze" kreuzen den Weg, nur die Augen offen halten.

(Translated by Google) This location commemorates the landing of the first European expedition to explore the Southeastern United States. The visitor can choose between two tours, whereby I chose the shorter one (due to the storm coming up). The tour led through untouched nature. The highlight for me was clearly the life-size figures that the locals and Europeans showed when they met and in everyday life. When I saw the first one, I was terrified because I thought that there really was a person there and that I might be waiting for me. Very original and it was great fun to walk the tour.

(Original)
Dieser Ort erinnert an die Landung der ersten Expedition von Europäern zur Erkundung des Südostens der USA. Der Besucher kann zwischen zwei Rundgängen wählen, wobei ich mich für den kürzeren entschieden habe (aufgrund des aufziehenden Unwetters). Der Rundgang führte durch unberührte Natur. Das Highlight waren für mich eindeutig die aufgestellten lebensgroßen Figuren, die die Einheimischen als auch Europäer bei ihrer Begegnung und im Alltag zeigen. Als ich die erste gesehen habe, habe ich mich wahnsinnig erschrocken, da ich dachte, da steht wirklich ein Mensch und lauert mir womöglich auf. Sehr originell und es war ein großer Spaß, den Rundgang zu laufen.

(Translated by Google) Mission San Luis is an open air museum. It shows the remains of a settlement of the Apalachee Indians and the mission station. The area is beautiful to look at and information boards explain life at that time, as are guides who can be found in the costume of that time. The huge Indian assembly house is also impressive. Only I always had the impression that the coexistence of the Indians and the Christians had not been as peaceful as it is portrayed. When asked about this by the guides, I received no direct answer, but this was an answer enough for me, that is, my impression had not disappointed me.

(Original)
Mission San Luis ist ein Freilichtmuseum. Es zeigt Reste einer Siedlung der Apalachee-Indianer und der Missionsstation. Die Anlage ist schön anzusehen und Hinweistafeln erklären das damalige Leben, ebenso Guides, die in der damaligen Tracht anzutreffen sind. Beeindruckend auch das riesige indianische Versammlungshaus. Nur hatte ich ständig den Eindruck, als wäre das Zusammenleben der Indianer und der Christen nicht so friedlich gewesen, wie es dargestellt wird. Die Guides darauf angesprochen, erhielt ich keine direkte Antwort, aber dies war mir Antwort genug, sprich mein Eindruck hatte mich nicht getäuscht.
dislikes: Portrayal of coexistence as overly peaceful

reviews_attraction.text:
(Translated by Google) Palace owned by railroad magnate Henry Morrison Flagler and beautifully situated on the water. The house itself impresses with its elegance and the originally furnished rooms. Some of the rooms are very hard to get used to, as wallpaper and furniture are sometimes in the same, sometimes garish, design (especially a bedroom with yellow flowers and green leaves - this was really the craziest room). Also very interesting is the walk-in railroad car with the original interior. Be sure to look at the fountain in the courtyard of the house. Mr. Flagler has shown a lot of humor here.

(Original)
Palast, der dem Eisenbahn-Magnaten Henry Morrison Flagler gehört hat und wunderschön am Wasser gelegen ist. Das Haus selber besticht durch seine Eleganz und die original eingerichteten Räume. Teilweise sind die Räume sehr gewöhnungsbedürftig eingerichtet, da stellenweise Tapete und Möbel im selben, mitunter grellen, Design gestaltet sind (speziell ein Schlafzimmer mit gelben Blumen und grünen Blättern - das war wirklich der verrückteste Raum). Sehr interessant auch der begehbare Eisenbahnwagon mit original Interieur. Unbedingt sich den Brunnen im Innenhof des Hauses anschauen. Hier hat Mr. Flagler viel Humor bewiesen.

(Translated by Google) The plant and animal painter J. J. Audubon lived here. In addition to the living rooms with precious furniture from the 18th / 19th Century engravings of the artist are shown. Subtropical and tropical plants bloom in the garden. The museum is relatively small and was absolutely not overcrowded during my visit.

A walk through Key West away from the so-called main street (s) is also worth seeing. Key West has some very nice (wooden) houses and front gardens. It is also not so crowded off the main street / s.

(Original)
Hier wohnte der Pflanzen- und Tiermaler J. J. Audubon. Neben den Wohnräumen mit kostbarem Mobiliar aus dem 18./19. Jahrhundert werden Originalstiche des Künstlers gezeigt. Im Garten blühen subtropische und tropische Pflanzen. Das Museum ist relativ klein und war zu meinem Besuch absolut nicht überlaufen.

Ferner ist ein Spaziergang durch Key West abseits der sog. Hauptstraße/n sehenswert. Key West hat einige sehr schöne (Holz)Häuser und Vorgärten zu bieten. Auch ist es abseits der Hauptstraße/n nicht so überlaufen.

(Translated by Google) Be there right at the beginning of the opening hours so that you can enjoy the lighthouse and the wonderful view alone. So I can not say whether this is generally heavily visited. Definitely worth a visit and pay a visit to the "Ernest Hemingway Home & Museum".

A walk through Key West away from the so-called main street (s) is also worth seeing. Key West has some very nice (wooden) houses and front gardens. It is also not so crowded off the main street / s.

(Original)
Gleich zu Beginn der Öffnungszeit da sein, so dass sie den Leuchtturm und die herrliche Aussicht alleine genießen können. Ob dieser generell stark besucht wird, kann ich somit nicht sagen. Auf jeden Fall einen Besuch wert und gleich gegenüber noch dem "Ernest Hemingway Home & Museum" einen Besuch abstatten.

Ferner ist ein Spaziergang durch Key West abseits der sog. Hauptstraße/n sehenswert. Key West hat einige sehr schöne (Holz)Häuser und Vorgärten zu bieten. Auch ist es abseits der Hauptstraße/n nicht so überlaufen.

(Translated by Google) Open-air museum reminiscent of the early days of white colonization in Florida. The open-air museum is lovingly designed. In the few houses there are many furnishings of the time, also can be seen various agricultural equipment. In my view, explanatory panels are missing, but the cashier has been able to answer all my questions. Impressive also the really monstrous cash register, but that was DAMALS just the same.

(Original)
Freilichtmuseum, das an die Frühzeit der weißen Besiedlung Floridas erinnert. Das Freilichtmuseum ist liebevoll gestaltet. In den wenigen Häusern finden sich viele Einrichtungsgegenstände der damaligen Zeit, auch sind diverse landwirtschaftliche Gerätschaften zu sehen. Aus meiner Sicht fehlen Erklärungstafeln, aber die Kassiererin hat mir im Anschluss alle meine Fragen beantworten können. Beeindruckend auch die wirklich monströse Kasse, aber das war DAMALS eben so.

(Translated by Google) This is a beautiful state park and is dedicated to Florida's particular wildlife. The famous manatees (manatees) can also be experienced live here. Ok, not really live, because these are taken care of after accidents, and they only show up when they are fed with salad. Also nice the many flamingos. Because of the many birds, this place is also called "Birder's Paradise".

(Original)
Dies ist ein wunderschöner State Park und widmet sich im besonderen Floridas Tierwelt. Hier sind auch die berühmten Manatis (Seekühe) live zu erleben. Ok, nicht wirklich live, da diese hier nach Unfällen gesundgepflegt werden, und auch erst bei der Fütterung mit Salat lassen sie sich sehen. Auch schön die vielen Flamingos. Aufgrund der vielen Vögel heißt dieser Ort auch "Birder's Paradise".

(Translated by Google) It used to be a cotton, sugar cane and orange plantation. Today the main house, kitchen house and the ruins of the slave dwellings can be visited. The main house is really grand with many amenities. The slave dwellings, on the other hand, were / were small and I prefer not to imagine how people lived here, if I can call it that.

(Original)
Früher war diese eine Baumwoll-, Zuckerrohr- und Orangenplantage. Heute sind das Haupthaus, Küchenhaus und die Ruinen der Sklavenbehausungen zu besichtigen. Das Haupthaus ist richtig herrschaftlich mit vielen Annehmlichkeiten. Die Sklavenbehausungen sind/waren dagegen klein und ich mag mir lieber nicht vorstellen, wie hier die Menschen gewohnt haben, wenn ich dies überhaupt so nennen kann.

(Translated by Google) The building complex includes the Casa González-Alvarez from 1702, recognizable by the four flags, and the Manucy Museum of St. Augustine History. The Casa itself captivates with the original preserved rooms and furnishings. Here the history of the Casa comes to life again. The small garden invites you to take a break.

(Original)
Der Gebäudekomplex umfasst die Casa González-Alvarez aus dem Jahre 1702, zu erkennen an den vier Flaggen, und das Manucy Museum of St. Augustine History. Die Casa selbst besticht durch die Original erhaltenen Räume und Einrichtungsgegenstände. Hier wird die Geschichte der Casa wieder lebendig. Der kleine Garten lädt zu einer Pause ein.

(Translated by Google) This was once a religious and cultural center for the Indians. You can see six mighty hills that served as Indian sanctuaries and burial mounds. The museum was unfortunately closed during my visit. The park offers a lot of untouched nature, also there were no other visitors during my stay, also nice.

(Original)
Dies war einst ein religiöses und kulturelles Zentrum der Indianer. Zu sehen sind sechs mächtige Hügel, die als Heiligtümer und Grabhügel der Indianer dienten. Das Museum war leider während meines Besuchs geschlossen. Der Park bietet viel unberührte Natur, auch gab es während meines Aufenthaltes dort keine weiteren Besucher, auch schön.

(Translated by Google) This is a botanical garden with lush tropical and subtropical vegetation. I particularly liked the variety of plants, because in places it looked like in the jungle. Many things also blossomed that were previously unknown to me. A really nice pastime.

(Original)
Dies ist ein Botanischer Garten mit einer üppigen tropischen und subtropischen Vegetation. Die Pflanzenvielfalt hat mir besonders gefallen, da es stellenweise wie im Urwald anmutete. Auch blühte so manches, was mir bis dato unbekannt war. Ein wirklich schöner Zeitvertreib.

(Translated by Google) Lighthouse made of red clinker bricks, which of course wants to be climbed on foot and offers a great view of the surroundings from above. Interesting also the most different lanterns (no idea whether this is the right term). Small but nice.

(Original)
Leuchtturm aus roten Klinkern, der natürlich zu Fuß bestiegen werden will und von oben einen tollen Blick in die Umgebung bittet. Interessant auch die unterschiedlichsten Laternen (keine Ahnung ob dies der richtige Begriff ist). Klein, aber fein.

(Translated by Google) It can only be reached by ferry and this also ensures that there are never too many visitors at once. The fort itself is not particularly large, but it does offer an insight into how the soldiers used to live here and secure the area.

(Original)
Nur per Fähre zu erreichen und so ist auch sichergestellt, dass nie zu viele Besucher auf einmal dort sind. Das Fort selber ist nicht sonderlich groß, bietet aber einen Einblick, wie die Soldaten damals hier gelebt und die Umgebung gesichert haben.

(Translated by Google) Red brick lighthouse that can be seen from afar. The lighthouse is picturesque and there is a wide view of the surrounding area from the observation deck. - Too bad that the tower can only be visited as part of a guided tour.

(Original)
Leuchtturm aus roten Ziegeln, der schon von weitem zu sehen ist. Der Leuchtturm liegt malerisch und von der Aussichtsplattform gibt es einen weiten Blick ins Umland. - Schade, dass der Turm nur im Rahmen einer geführten Tour besichtigt werden kann.

(Translated by Google) Located almost right next to Homosassa Springs Wildlife State Park and well worth a detour. A former sugar cane plantation can be visited here. An educational trail provides information on sugar production. Very informative.

(Original)
Quasi direkt neben dem Homosassa Springs Wildlife State Park gelegen und ist einen Abstecher wert. Hier kann eine ehemalige Zuckerrohrplantage besichtigt werden. Ein Lehrpfad informiert über die Zuckergewinnung. Sehr informativ.

(Translated by Google) Beautiful garden with an exotic flora with orchids, Everglades marsh and orange trees. In between there are flamingos, alligators and other unknown birds. It is a pleasure to watch the wildlife.

(Original)
Wunderschöner Garten mit einer exotischen Pflanzenwelt mit Orchideen, Sumpfland der Everglades und Orangenbäumen. Dazwischen tummeln sich Flamingos, Alligatoren und weitere unbekannte Vögel. Es ist ein Vergnügen, der Tierwelt zuzuschauen.

(Translated by Google) Stalactite cave that can be visited as part of a tour. The structures in the cave are beautiful and stimulate the imagination. In places the floor is a bit damp and with a little luck you may also see bats.

(Original)
Tropfsteinhöhle, die im Rahmen einer Tour besichtigt werden darf. Die Gebilde in der Höhle sind wunderschön und regen die Phantasie an. Stellenweise ist der Boden etwas feucht und mit etwas Glück sehen sie auch Fledermäuse.

(Translated by Google) Consists of porous coral lime with many holes. The flood creates high splashing fountains that are just fun. Also not very crowded and definitely worth a detour.

(Original)
Besteht aus porösem Korallenkalk mit vielen Löchern. Die Flut erzeugt hoch spritzende Fontänen, die einfach nur Spaß machen. Auch nicht sonderlich überlaufen und lohnt auf jeden Fall einen Abstecher.

The park itself is a beautiful place to visit. The small beach and its white sand is clean and well maintained. The park has a couple good hiking trails which have nice views of the Tampa Bay area. Their facilities are clean and well kept. It has numerous pavilions with cooking grills next to the picnic tables. The children's playground is nice and appears to be well maintained. The staff was nice and friendly. There were visible law enforcement officers at the time of our visit. The biggest problem with this park is that Hillsborough county is still charging an entrance fee, but most amenities are closed. The park's main attraction is its beach. However, it is closed. Also, all picnic tables are closed to visitors. However, the children's playground is open. This mentality doesn't make sense to us. Close all adult amenities but open the playground. Really? If the county's Park and Recreation is going to keep the beach closed, then, stop charging an entry fee. We can visit our neighborhood's  playground for free. Until the county reopens the beach, we'll not visit their parks again. From now on, we'll visit Manatee county's parks and beaches which don't charge an entry fee and are 100% open.

DeSoto National Memorial Park is a beautiful small park... It has a marking at the spot where it is believed that DeSoto and his Spaniard army landed... Has several markers on the DeSoto trails, where the Spanish had to fight mother nature as well as the Native American tribes who populated the region... Beautiful cross, about 30 ft in height, commemorates the 12 Spanish Priests that came ashore with DeSoto... Boardwalk is under construction... Gorgeous ocean view... The fort has 2-3; living quarters, a small outdoors chapel, supply room, a kitchen/dining area... No fee park. However, donate if you can...Bring water and mosquito spray... Good family park...

Awesome Victory ship and museum... Staff were very helpful, knowledgeable and friendly... Spend a few minutes talking to the ship's Chaplain. He knows so much history about the ship and shared some information with my daughter and I... Many historic artifacts everywhere... Bring lots of water as A/C is not available in ships from the 1940s... Gained a valuable lesson on the sacrificies made by our Merchant Marine service members... Museum relies on donations to stay open. Thus, donate, if you can, so that our history can be witnessed by future generations.

Great place run by an awesome staff. The habitat is a shelter for abused, neglected and abandoned big cats and any other wildlife. They shelter tigers, lions, bisons, turtles, goats and many other species. It offers free entrance to military ID card holders as well as veterans with proof of service. It has shows with an additional fee. All monies collected are used to care for the animals who reside at the shelter. If you visit consider donating to the habitat. Great place for the family to spend 2-3 hours. The kids loved it. Will visit again.

This aquarium is dedicated to save animals which have been injured while in their natural habitat. It has some beautiful dolphins as well as other marine life. It offers food to it's visitors, in the form of fast foods and drinks. We spent more time than planned ahead of our visit. However, all of us enjoyed it the visit. Hopefully, we will be able to visit again, soon. If you are able to donate, please do so as the facility relies on donations to help their acuatic friends.

Nice family Park which is located next to a beautiful botanical garden. The park is mainly for children from 2 to about 7-8. It has a playground, several tables and benches as well as a water pad. The park was cleaned and well maintained. However, the main building is closed due to the coronavirus. Public restrooms are open and were well kept. Plan to spend about an hour at the park. Children will enjoy it. Make sure to visit the botanical gardens next door.

Awesome nature preserve with 2 hiking trails. The longer trail is a moderate 1.7 hike, and the second trail is a moderate 1.4 miles long. The preserve is part of the Hillsborough county Hiking Spree program. If you're participating in the 2020 Spree, you have to complete your required 8 hikes during March. Bring water, mosquito repellent as well as waterproof hiking boots. Facilities available. Nice place for a family to complete a hike...

Awesome boardwalk, canoe rental, fishing, pavilions with grills everywhere, a hard-top 1.25 mile trail, playground  with a nice observation tower... Staff was nice... One of the nicest parks in Hillsborough county... If you are a "service connected" veteran, you can apply for a no-fee access pass good for 2 years; otherwise, entrance fee is $2.00 per vehicle... Bring water, sunscreen and mosquito spray... Good family place...

awesome family park with a gorgeous tower. The park is a very peaceful and relaxing place where humans and animals come together. It has an awesome trail. Flowers and animals everywhere. The staff was friendly and helpful. The facilities were clean. We were informed that the park will be closing due to the virus affecting our country as well as the rest of the world. We'll return once it is reopen.

Nice little park with a trail (easy) about 3+ miles... Veterans (Service Connected) can get a Hillsborough county park 3-year pass with a VA ID and proof of county residence... The pass gives you access to all county parks and preserves... Restrooms in building were clean; we saw only one picnic table and no grills... staff were friendly and very helpful...Bring water and mosquito repellent...

Too many stores to count... Sea food available everywhere... Mostly, pubs are located on 2nd floor... Game and music rooms... Educational material as well as displays... Souvenir shops... Clothing stores... Information booth has information about stores as well as coupons and maps for other local points of interest as well as hotels... family enjoyed visit... photo opportunities everywhere...

Nice community park. Has a very good skateboard bowl where people can practice their skills. Many grills but no picknick tables. Has a couple of basketball courts as well as a hardtop trail... Several awesome murals decorate a couple concrete walls. Nice sculptures can be seen at the park entrance... It has a beautiful water fountain that "dances." Well maintained.

While the preserve itself is an awesome place to hike, their restroom facility was in need of cleaning and some maintenance. The trail is an easy hike which the whole family enjoyed, young as well as the adults. At the entrance there is a gorgeous pavilion where people can grill. We'll no be returning until the county cleans their facilities.

Beautiful, clean and peaceful beach... Nice place to spend a couple of hours with the family... Water is getting a little cold, so if you are planning a visit, make it sooner rather than later... Bring sunscreen and water... Several parks and a nature preserve within a couple of miles as well as a little known but awesome waterpark...

Awesome staff... clean swimming pool... great hiking trails... a bit to expensive  rentals... the cooking areas need to be sprayed as thousands of mosquitos prevented us from eating at the park... clean restrooms... support disabled veterans by issuing free lifetime access pass.. Bring lots of bug spray and sunscreen...

Awesome preserve with several trails and a historic mound top from the 1860s... Beach trail as well as fishing soots and a small boat launch... Observation tower... Clean and well maintained... A couple grills and picnic tables are available... Bring water and sunscreen...

Awesome private park... Staff was very friendly and helpful... Park depends on donations to remain open; thus, donate, if you can... It's packed with information about native and exotic flora... Bring water and sunscreen... Make sure to walk all passages...

3 bike trails... No foot traffic allowed... Bring out the mountain bikes and enjoy a nice trail with the family... Easy, medium, and difficult trails... No facilities or staff available... Bring lots of water, sunscreen and mosquito repellent...

Nice place to spend a couple hours with the family... Too bad their theater is closed... Expensive vegan food available... Lots of bar and grills... My wife loved the German food...bring sunscreen and water... Lots of murals...

Awesome park to spend a few hours grilling and bathing in the Spring... Staff are very professional, helpful and friendly... Clean and well kept facilities... Kids loved it... Bring lots of sunscreen and water...
Nice county park...The boardwalk is about half a mile... Has picnic area. Clean public restrooms... Fee per car is $2.00... very well kept... Flora is spread throughout the park...
Easy 2.67-mile trail... Exercise stations, basketball court and picnic tables... Clean and well maintained... No staff and no facilities... Bring lots of sunscreen and water...
Boat launch is the main reason to go to this park... very few picnic tables available... Clean facilities... No staff... rowing training facilities on site...
The park was nice and a good place to take the family... However, the staff were not very friendly or helpful... Will not visit again...
Beautiful historic place... Nice family shops offer lots of sponge products at reasonable prices... Parking is provided for a fee...

(Translated by Google) This stunning attraction by Bella is fully interactive.
The cast members strive to integrate the little ones (and the not so little ones) into this story of beauty.

It has different rooms to very effectively carry the theme of waiting, which is usually high due to the attractiveness of the attraction.

In the first chamber you are greeted by the wardrobe that speaks and prepares the characters that will participate in the story. Then magically the mirror opens in the shape of a door and lets you pass to the 2nd room where Lumier invites you to surprise Bella when she enters.

All these moments are captured by a Photopass photographer who then hands you a card to download all the photos.

(Original)
Esta impresionante atracción de Bella es totalmente interactiva.
Los cast members se esfuerzan en integrar a los pequeños (y los no tan pequeños) a esta historia de bella.

Tiene diferentes salones para llevar de forma muy efectiva el tema de las esperas, que suelen ser altas por lo llamativa de la atracción.

En la primera cámara te recibe el armario que habla y prepara los personajes que van a participar en el cuento. Luego de forma mágica el espejo se abre en forma de puerta y te deja pasar a la 2da habitación donde Lumier te invita a sorprender a Bella cuando entra.

Todos estos momentos son capturados por un fotógrafo de Photopass que luego te entrega una tarjeta para que descargues todas las fotos.

(Translated by Google) At Disney Hollywood Studios, fans of the StarWars behind could include their little Jedi in training and later fighting against the dark side.
DHS offers a 30-minute training that begins with a talk and dresses children between 4-12 years old in the famous jedi brown robes.
Then they all march together to the temple and that is where the practice begins that ends with a fight against DarthVader or Kilo Ren.
All these moments are covered by Photopass photographers.
Negative aspect, everything happens outdoors and therefore is suspended due to rain or on very hot days, children can suffer from sunstroke.

(Original)
En Disney Hollywood Studios los fanáticos de la zaga StarWars podrían incluir a sus pequeños Jedi en un entrenamiento y posterior lucha contra el lado oscuro.
DHS ofrece un training de 30min que inicia con una charla y visten a los pequeños entre 4-12 años con las famosas batas marrones jedi.
Luego marchan todos juntos al templo y es allí donde inicia la práctica que termina con una lucha contra DarthVader o Kilo Ren.
Todos estos momentos son cubiertos por fotógrafos de Photopass.
Aspecto negativo, todo ocurre al aire libre y por lo tanto se suspende por lluvia o en días de mucho calor los pequeños pueden sufrir de insolación.

(Translated by Google) By far I consider that Flight of Passage is the best attraction of the entire Walt Disney World complex. Your level of immersion, high technology and virtual reality is without a doubt extraordinary.
It is also the ride that generates the longest lines of the entire complex. Reaching peaks of 200 minutes or more in high season.
This makes it the most longed for fastpass of all.
Do not hesitate to make your line and enjoy this ride that from the waiting you will be surprised with excellent facilities as if you were in the laboratory of scientific studies.

(Original)
Por mucho considero que Flight of Passage es la mejor atracción de todo el complejo de Walt Disney World. Su nivel de inmersión, la alta tecnología y la realidad virtual es sin duda extraordinaria.
también es el ride que genera más largas filas de todo el complejo. Alcanzando picos de 200 minutos o más en temporada alta.
Esto lo convierte en el fastpass más ansiado de todos.
No duden en hacer su fila y disfrutar de este ride que desde la espera te sorprenden con excelentes instalaciones como si estuvieras en el laboratorio de estudios científicos.

(Translated by Google) Excellent spot something hidden where you can meet Mickey's friends. You will mainly find Daysi, Donald, Pluto and Goofy.
It is located in front of the water playground.
It is comfortably indoors, it is actually a huge circus tent with air conditioning. Ideal to rest in summer days with a lot of heat and humidity. Outside the tent you can buy the famous turkey leg or turkey legs.
It's worth it for the little ones to enjoy

(Original)
Excelente spot algo escondido donde podrás conocer a los amigos de Mickey. Principalmente encontrarás a Daysi, Donald, Pluto y Goofy.
Está ubicado frente al patio de juegos de agua.
Está cómodamente bajo techo, en realidad es una enorme carpa de circo  con aire acondicionado. Ideal para descansar en jornadas de verano con mucho calor y humedad.  Afuera de la carpa podrás comprar las famosas turkey leg o patas de pavo.
Vale la pena para que los pequeños disfruten

(Translated by Google) This is the 2nd attraction that Pandora offers. It is certainly not as famous as Flight of Passage, however it helps to diminish the wait in this.
The ride is a comfortable and relaxed tour by an artificial river that runs through different areas of the Mo'ara Valley. You can enjoy watching the Pandora animals. And the tour ends with the typical song of the natives through the most advanced Animatronics of all Disney. Impeccable.

(Original)
Esta es la 2da atracción que ofrece Pandora. Sin duda no es tan famosa como Flight of Passage, sin embargo ayuda a disminuir las esperas en esta.
El ride es un recorrido cómodo y relajado por un río artificial que recorre diferentes zonas Del Valle de Mo’ara. Podrás disfrutar de observar a los animales de Pandora. Y el recorrido termina con el canto típico de los nativos por medio del Animatronics más avanzado de todo Disney. Impecable.

(Translated by Google) Without a doubt, this roller coaster is the best thing about the new toy story Land.
It was designed as a children's attraction, however the minimum height to access is 40 ”.
The experience is lived from the waiting line,
Where you can see how Andy built the attraction with parts of the toy kit.
Before closing the ride, the attraction stops right in front of a Wheezy who sings "I am your faithful friend" in English.
Safety pin.

(Original)
Sin duda alguna esta montaña rusa es lo mejor que tiene la nueva toy story Land.
Fue diseñada como una atracción infantil, sin embargo la altura mínima para acceder son 40”.
La experiencia se vive desde la fila de espera,
Donde podrás observar cómo Andy construyó la atracción con partes del kit de juguete.
La atracción antes de cerrar su recorrido se detiene justo frente a un Wheezy que canta “Yo soy tu amigo fiel” en inglés.
Imperdible.

(Translated by Google) Since we started planning the trip to Miami, we read some blogs that talked about the Venetian Pool, in Coral Gables ...
This huge pool is set as its name suggests in the famous public pools of Venice.
It has some fruits and caves with waterfalls and waterfalls that make it very attractive for young and old.
For non-residents of Coral Gables it has a cost of 15 USD (adults) and 10 USD (children).
Highly recommended

(Original)
Desde que empezamos a planear el viaje a Miami, leímos algunos blogs que hablaban de la Venetian Pool, en Coral Gables...
Esta enorme piscina está ambientada como su nombre indica en las famosas piscinas públicas de Venecia.
Tiene algunas frutas y cuevas con cascadas y Caídas de agua que lo hacen muy atractivo para grandes y pequeños.
Para los no residentes de coral gables tiene un costo de 15 USD (adultos) y 10 USD (niños).
Muy recomendable

(Translated by Google) This space is within the
Epcot's Future World zone and is designed to meet and interact with Disney characters.
Currently you have the option to meet Sadness and Joy from Intensamente, there are also Baymax from Big Hero 6 and in another sector are Mickey, Minnie and Goofy.
It is advisable to previously seek a fast pass for Mickey and his friends, since the lines are long; especially in high season.

(Original)
Este espacio se encuentra dentro de la
Zona de Future World de Epcot y está diseñado para conocer e interactuar con personajes de Disney.
Actualmente tienes la Opción de conocer a Tristeza y Alegria de Intensamente, también están Baymax de Big Hero 6 y en otro sector están Mickey, Minnie y Goofy.
Recomendable buscar previamente un fast pass para Mickey y sus amigos, ya que las filas son largas; especialmente en temporada alta.

(Translated by Google) The Town Square theater is widely known by all visitors to Magic Kingdom because there they can find famous Mickey Mouse.
Previously this Mickey was the most longed for to know because he interacted with you speaking ...
This changed in mid-2018 when Disney removed this technology.
It is recommended that you take a fast pass for this match because the rows usually exceed 70/90 minutes of waiting.

(Original)
El teatro de Town Square es ampliamente conocidos por todos los visitantes de Magic Kingdom porque ahí podrán encontrar a famoso Mickey Mouse.
Anteriormente este Mickey era el más ansiado de conocer porque interactuaba contigo hablando...
Esto cambio a mediados del 2018 cuando Disney removió esta tecnología.
Es recomendable que saques fast pass para este encuentro porque las filas suelen sobrepasar los 70/90 minutos de espera.

(Translated by Google) This is the gateway to the famous Tomorrowland sector of the Magic Kingdom.
It is crossed by a well-known arch and is a special spot for taking photos.
Some select hours you will be able to find a Photopass photographer located at this point.
Tomorrowland is the futuristic sector of the park. With attractions known as Buzz lightyear, interacting with stich, the people moover, is speedway and space mountain.

(Original)
Este es el puente de entrada al famoso sector Tomorrowland de Magic Kingdom.
Está franqueado por un arco muy conocido y es un spot especial para tomar fotos.
Algunas horas selectas podrás encontrar a un fotógrafo de Photopass ubicado en este punto.
Tomorrowland es el sector futurista del parque. Con atracciones conocidas como Buzz lightyear, interactuar con stich, el people moover, es speedway y space mountain.

(Translated by Google) Without a doubt for many and many this would be the best live show you could enjoy at Disney Hollywood Studios.
This is because it is the most recent and with a very well set and high-tech theater-type studio.
The show takes place within the history of the film in the best live musical style.
In the end the closing is impressive, being able to witness an artificial snowfall.
Enjoy this show.

(Original)
Sin duda para muchos y muchas este sería el mejor show en vivo que podrías disfrutar en Disney Hollywood Studios.
Esto se debe a que es el más reciente y con un estudio tipo teatro muy bien ambientado y con alta tecnología.
El show transcurre dentro de la historia de la película al mejor estilo musical en vivo.
Al final el cierre es impresionante, pudiendo presenciar una nevada artificial.
Disfruten de este show.

(Translated by Google) The princess Fairytale hall is the place designed by Disney to meet its most famous princesses.
This room is divided into 2 large areas with independent rows where you can meet 3 or 4 princesses.
On this occasion (September 2018) the row on the right allowed interaction with Cinderella and Elena de Avalor.
The regular row was at 50min while the row with fastpass took about 15min.

Este salón está dividido en 2 grandes áreas con filas independientes donde podrás conocer 3 o 4 princesas.
En esta ocasión (Septiembre 2018) la fila de la derecha permitía interactuar con Cenicienta y con Elena de Avalor.
La fila regular estaba en 50min mientras que la fila con fastpass tomaba cerca de 15min.

(Translated by Google) Definitely there is no postcard that best represents the happiest place on the planet than the Cinderella Castle.
We are talking about Magic Kingdom.
The most visited amusement park in the world.
This castle houses varied visiting options such as
Restaurant Cinderella's royal table and the Bibbidi Bobbidi hairdressing boutique, where they transform girls into real Disney Pincesas
